main_text.p: pacitatis duellantes digladiare, quam aream milites arcte stipati circumdederant ; haftas in aream directas tenentes mucronibus in corpora gladiatorum directis, ut si paululum secederet alter, ilico in haftas retrolabi posset, quo stratagemate perterrefacere voluit eos qui facile ad singulare certamé provocarent. Quod factum in tantum probandum censeo, in quantum non permittendum eos ad arma venire, verum solū impediendi eorum conatus. Aliter foret medium ad evitationem quidem duellorum excogitatum, non tamen in conscientia licitum, aut permissum. Nihil autem mihi magis videretur infringere licentiam illam duellantium, quam si quotquot duello provocare alios volunt, veniam tenerentur impetrare, à principe, aut exercitus duce. Qui tum, si

page.notes: Catchword "for-" is set at the lower right and is left out of the text. Scan edge marks and specks at the bottom and right are not printed text and are omitted. Accents and macrons (certamé, solū, duellorum) are transcribed as they appear on the scan; the macron on "duellorum" is faint and may be a stroke over the u, read here as plain "duellorum". Line-end hyphens are kept where printed (digladia-, gladiato-, mu-, stratage-, evita-, per-, ma-, licen-, tenéren-).
